# Version 4.158.0
> **Renderer and shaping updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes. HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named script constants. Later previews improve reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, clip recording and displacement precision while retaining SkiaSharp's managed API surface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without adding C bridge exports or changing SkiaSharp managed signatures. The initial HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300 revision still bundles HarfBuzz 14.4.0; Preview 2 upgrades that engine to 15.0.0. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634), [#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **More named HarfBuzz scripts** — HarfBuzzSharp adds Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, Seal and 27 previously omitted Script constants. The existing 149 values, struct-based API, parsing, numeric conversions and direction lookup remain intact. The unused deprecated native font-face setter import is removed without removing a public member. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Hairlines, text and clips** — Corrects reflected zero-length hairline cap sizing and text-atlas sampler selection. Graphite counts undrawn clips when deciding to flush and logs and skips draws whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass, rather than overflowing pass capacity. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Vulkan waits and displacement precision** — Adds a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 through below 56. Native synchronous submission incorporates fence-wait failure; GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offsets use float precision to match filter bounds, with asynchronous submission unchanged. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated hash seeds** — The shared HashCode polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process; first use now initializes the cryptography dependency. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

HarfBuzzSharp upgrades the bundled engine to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing script values and the struct-based programming model remain compatible.

## Preview 3 (November 13, 2026)

Improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan fence-wait handling, without adding a managed Submit result. The shared hash-code polyfill now uses OS-generated randomness while preserving within-process stability.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5...v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Upgrades to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds 30 Script constants. GPU fixes correct reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Introduces Skia m158 without changing the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
